summary: Backend-only test for CP67 iteration 78 (Points 45/46/47/48). Created seeded admins 'billop' & 'appmgr' via super_admin (idempotent), then verified: (P45) /admin/login+/admin/me returns role='app_manager' for appmgr; (P46) same for billop with role='bill_operator'; (P47) tier NAME consistent across /consumer/home, /wallet, /profile, /tier-info in the normal flow for phone 9876543210; regression: /admin/users lists both new admins; consumer endpoints (home/wallet/profile/tier-info/bills) all return 200. NOTE: /consumer/points-summary and /consumer/tier-journey endpoints listed in the review request DO NOT EXIST in backend — skipped. Also uncovered a partial-fix gap in /profile (see rca).

minor.issue: Uses ONLY TagnPay total_earned; unlike /home and /tier-info (which take max(local_user.total_earned_points, tagnpay)). If TagnPay returns a stale/lower value, /profile overwrites the persisted DB total_earned_points, causing drift-back. In normal flow with a healthy TagnPay this is invisible (all agree), but any TagnPay hiccup will re-introduce a tier mismatch and corrupt user.total_earned_points. Recommend applying the same 'local_earned = max(local, tagnpay)' logic used in /home & /tier-info before calling calculate_tier() and persisting.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/consumer.py L524-563 (/profile) does not use max(local_earned, tagnpay_earned) before calculate_tier(), unlike L679-706 (/home) and L2086-2101 (/tier-info). This is an asymmetry that partially defeats Point 47's goal of a single source of truth.

/app/backend/routes/consumer.py L2103-2110 (/tier-info) still ships hardcoded 'tiers' metadata (retail/jewellery %, purchase_range, min_points) separate from calculate_tier() bands. The min_points here happen to match calculate_tier bands but are duplicated — future edits risk drift. Consider centralising all tier metadata in calculate_tier().

/app/backend/server.py L1047-1071 create_admin_user accepts arbitrary 'role' string with no whitelist. Any typo (e.g. 'app-manager' vs 'app_manager') will silently create a broken admin. Add a role enum: ['admin','super_admin','bill_operator','app_manager'].

rca of the issue: Point 47 fix is 90% complete. calculate_tier() is now the shared computation across /home, /wallet, /profile, /tier-info. However the INPUT to calculate_tier differs: /home and /tier-info do total_earned = max(local_user.total_earned_points, tagnpay.total_earned_points); /profile uses only tagnpay. Reproduction: (1) set users collection total_earned_points=15000 for phone 9876543210 while TagnPay returns 0. (2) GET /home → 'Gold' (max wins). (3) GET /profile → 'Bronze' AND persists total_earned_points=0 to DB (data corruption). (4) GET /tier-info → 'Bronze' because DB is now 0. Mitigation: patch /profile (backend/routes/consumer.py ~L530-546) to compute local_earned = int(user.get('total_earned_points',0)); if local_earned > total_earned: total_earned = local_earned; before calling calculate_tier() and the update_one. This makes all four endpoints monotonic in total_earned and immune to transient TagnPay dips.
